card.name: Verbs after "drugs that" in interactions
card.fires_on: The verb right after "drugs that" or "agents that" in interaction warnings, mostly "affect" (the RAAS, the RAS, coagulation) and also "induce" or "inhibit".

modes.label: Drugs that affect
modes.description: "affect" after "drugs/agents that" before a body system such as the RAS or coagulation.
modes.example: Changes in renal function, including acute renal failure, can be caused by drugs that<< affect>> the RAAS.

modes.label: Induce or inhibit
modes.description: Enzyme-related verbs after "drugs which" or in "Drugs that Inhibit" headings.
modes.example: 5.9 Interaction with St. John’s Wort or Rifampin Drugs which<< induce>> CYP2C19 or C

modes.label: Product contains
modes.description: The verb "contain" after a tablet name at the start of a warning.
modes.example: WARNINGS Minoxidil tablets<< contain>> the powerful antihypertensive agent

card.plain: It fires on the action verb that says what an interacting drug does, such as "drugs that affect the RAS".
